entry.name: jit.ui.group
entry.digest: Group other UI objects into an interactive container
entry.description: Use jit.ui.group to organise and automatically position jit.ui objects in the rendering window.

attributes.digest: How the UI objects in the group align on the vertical axis (default="space-evenly")
attributes.description: How the UI objects in the group align on the vertical axis (default="space-evenly").Check the reference to see the possible values.
